title: Intro to Python
line: Variables, loops, functions and files. Your first real scripts.

project.title: A number guessing game
project.brief: Write guess.py on your own. Pick a random number, loop until the guess is right, say higher or lower, and save the best score to a file.
checks: The right number ends the game with the number of tries
The best score is written to scores.txt

lessons.title: Run your first Python file
lessons.goal: Teach a complete beginner to create hello.py in VS Code, print two lines and run it from the terminal with python3.
lessons.passes: hello.py runs and prints both lines.

lessons.title: Variables and numbers
lessons.goal: Teach Python variables and arithmetic by building a tip calculator in tip.py with a bill, a tip percent and a total.
lessons.passes: tip.py prints the right total for a 40 dollar bill at 20 percent.

lessons.title: Strings and f-strings
lessons.goal: Teach Python strings, indexing, upper and lower, and f-strings by printing a name badge from two variables.
lessons.passes: The badge prints the name in capitals inside an f-string.

lessons.title: If, elif and else
lessons.goal: Teach Python comparisons and if, elif, else by writing a ticket price picker for child, adult and senior ages.
lessons.passes: Ages 8, 30 and 70 each print the right price.

lessons.title: For and while loops
lessons.goal: Teach Python for loops with range and while loops by printing a times table and a countdown that stops at zero.
lessons.passes: The times table has ten rows and the countdown ends at zero.

lessons.title: Lists
lessons.goal: Teach Python lists by building a shopping list. Append, remove, sort, slice and loop over it.
lessons.passes: The list prints sorted with the removed item gone.

lessons.title: Functions
lessons.goal: Teach Python functions with parameters and return values by turning the tip calculator into a function and calling it three times.
lessons.passes: A function with two parameters returns the total and is called three times.

lessons.title: Dictionaries
lessons.goal: Teach Python dictionaries by counting how often each word appears in a sentence and printing the top three.
lessons.passes: The word counts match the sentence.

lessons.title: Read and write a file
lessons.goal: Teach reading and writing text files in Python with open and with, by saving a list of scores to scores.txt and reading it back.
lessons.passes: scores.txt exists and the script prints what it holds.

lessons.title: Read an error message
lessons.goal: Teach a beginner to read Python tracebacks by fixing three small broken scripts, a NameError, a TypeError and an IndexError.
lessons.passes: All three scripts run with no error.
